questions.title: Native Sidecar Container
questions.body:
Team Neptune runs a web app that must ship its access logs to a co-located agent. In Namespace `exam-q1` create a Pod named `web-logger` with:

1. A main container named `web` using image `nginx:1.27-alpine`.
2. A **native sidecar** container named `log-agent` using image `busybox:1.36`. Implement it as an init container with `restartPolicy: Always` and command `sh -c 'tail -F /var/log/nginx/access.log'`.

Both containers must share an `emptyDir` volume named `logs` mounted at `/var/log/nginx`. Save the manifest at `/opt/course/p1/web-logger.yaml` and apply it.

questions.title: Choose the Workload — DaemonSet
questions.body:
Team Pluto needs a monitoring agent running on every node. In Namespace `exam-q2` create a DaemonSet named `node-agent` with:

- Image `busybox:1.36`
- Command `sh -c 'while true; do echo agent alive; sleep 30; done'`
- Pod label `app=node-agent`

Confirm one Pod is scheduled per node.

questions.title: Rolling Update Strategy
questions.body:
In Namespace `exam-q3` there is a Deployment named `frontend` (image `nginx:1.24-alpine`, `6` replicas).

1. Configure its update strategy to `RollingUpdate` with `maxSurge: 2` and `maxUnavailable: 0`.
2. Update the container image to `nginx:1.27-alpine`.
3. Wait for the rollout to finish and confirm all replicas are updated.

questions.title: Blue/Green Deployment
questions.body:
In Namespace `exam-q4` there is a Deployment named `app-blue` with label `version=blue` (image `nginx:1.24-alpine`) and a Service named `app-svc` whose selector currently routes to `version=blue`.

Perform a blue/green switch:
1. Create a new Deployment named `app-green` with `3` replicas, labels `app=app` and `version=green`, image `nginx:1.27-alpine`.
2. Once `app-green` Pods are Ready, switch the Service `app-svc` selector so traffic goes to `version=green`.

Save the green Deployment at `/opt/course/p4/app-green.yaml`.

questions.title: Kustomize Overlay
questions.body:
A Kustomize base for Team Mars lives at `/opt/course/p5/base` (a Deployment `mars-api` with image `nginx:1.24-alpine` and `1` replica).

Create an overlay at `/opt/course/p5/overlay` that:
- References the base
- Sets the replica count of `mars-api` to `4`
- Changes the image to `nginx:1.27-alpine`

Apply the overlay into Namespace `exam-q5` using `kubectl apply -k`.

questions.title: Helm Release
questions.body:
A local Helm chart is available at `/opt/course/p6/webchart`.

1. Install it as release `web-release` into Namespace `exam-q6` with value `replicaCount=2`.
2. Verify the release is deployed and write the output of `helm list -n exam-q6` to `/opt/course/p6/release-status.txt`.
3. Upgrade the release to `replicaCount=3`.

The chart deploys a Deployment named `webchart`.

questions.title: Probes — Startup, Readiness, Liveness
questions.body:
In Namespace `exam-q7` there is a Deployment named `api-server` (image `nginx:1.27-alpine`, container port `80`).

Add all three health checks to its container:
- **startupProbe**: httpGet `/` on port `80`, `failureThreshold: 30`, `periodSeconds: 5`
- **readinessProbe**: httpGet `/` on port `80`, `initialDelaySeconds: 5`, `periodSeconds: 10`
- **livenessProbe**: httpGet `/` on port `80`, `initialDelaySeconds: 15`, `periodSeconds: 20`

Apply the change and confirm the Pods become Ready.

questions.title: Debug CrashLoopBackOff
questions.body:
In Namespace `exam-q8` the Deployment `data-processor` is in `CrashLoopBackOff`. It should run `3` healthy replicas.

Investigate with `kubectl describe`, `kubectl logs`, and `kubectl get events`. The container is meant to run `busybox:1.36` with command `sh -c 'while true; do echo processing; sleep 10; done'` but was deployed with a broken command.

Fix the Deployment so all `3` replicas are Running, and write the root cause into `/opt/course/p8/issues.txt`.

questions.title: API Deprecation Fix
questions.body:
The manifest `/opt/course/p9/legacy-ingress.yaml` uses a deprecated/removed API version (`networking.k8s.io/v1beta1`) and no longer applies on Kubernetes v1.35.

Rewrite it to the current `networking.k8s.io/v1` Ingress schema (it targets Service `legacy-svc` port `80` for host `legacy.ckad.com` path `/`, `pathType: Prefix`, `ingressClassName: nginx`). Save the corrected file in place at `/opt/course/p9/legacy-ingress.yaml` and apply it into Namespace `exam-q9`.

questions.title: ConfigMap and Secret Consumption
questions.body:
In Namespace `exam-q10`:

1. Create a ConfigMap named `web-config` with key `LOG_LEVEL` set to `info` and a file-style key `app.conf` whose content is `mode=prod`.
2. Create a Secret named `web-secret` with key `API_KEY` whose value is `abcd1234`.
3. Create a Pod named `consumer` using image `nginx:alpine` that:
   - Exposes `LOG_LEVEL` from the ConfigMap as an environment variable
   - Exposes `API_KEY` from the Secret as an environment variable
   - Mounts the ConfigMap as a volume at `/etc/web`

questions.title: SecurityContext and Capabilities
questions.body:
In Namespace `exam-q11` create a Pod named `hardened` using image `busybox:1.36` with command `sh -c 'sleep 3600'` and the following security posture:

- Run as user `1000` and group `2000`
- `runAsNonRoot: true`
- `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true`
- `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`
- Drop **all** Linux capabilities, then add only `NET_BIND_SERVICE`
- Mount an `emptyDir` at `/tmp` so the container can still write scratch data

questions.title: ResourceQuota and Requests/Limits
questions.body:
Namespace `exam-q12` has a ResourceQuota named `team-quota` limiting CPU and memory.

Create a Pod named `quota-pod` using image `nginx:alpine` that fits within the quota with:
- CPU request `100m`, CPU limit `250m`
- Memory request `128Mi`, Memory limit `256Mi`

Confirm the Pod is scheduled and inspect `kubectl describe resourcequota team-quota -n exam-q12` to see the updated usage.

questions.title: ServiceAccount and RBAC
questions.body:
In Namespace `exam-q13` an application needs read access to ConfigMaps and Secrets via its own identity.

1. Create a ServiceAccount named `reader-sa`.
2. Create a Role named `cm-secret-reader` allowing `get`, `list`, `watch` on `configmaps` and `secrets`.
3. Bind the Role to the ServiceAccount with a RoleBinding named `reader-binding`.
4. Create a Pod named `reader-pod` using image `nginx:alpine` that uses `reader-sa`.

Verify with `kubectl auth can-i list secrets -n exam-q13 --as=system:serviceaccount:exam-q13:reader-sa` (should return `yes`).

questions.title: Custom Resource from CRD
questions.body:
A CustomResourceDefinition `backups.stable.ckad.io` (kind `Backup`, scope Namespaced, group `stable.ckad.io`, version `v1`) is already installed in the cluster.

In Namespace `exam-q14` create a custom resource of kind `Backup` named `nightly` with spec fields:
- `schedule: "0 2 * * *"`
- `retention: 7`

Confirm the object exists with `kubectl get backups -n exam-q14`.

questions.title: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
questions.body:
In Namespace `exam-q15` there is a Deployment named `scaler-app` (image `nginx:1.27-alpine`) whose container already declares a CPU request of `100m`.

Create a HorizontalPodAutoscaler named `scaler-hpa` that targets the `scaler-app` Deployment with:
- `minReplicas: 2`
- `maxReplicas: 10`
- Target average CPU utilization of `70%`

Use the `autoscaling/v2` API.

questions.title: Troubleshoot a Service
questions.body:
In Namespace `exam-q16` a Deployment named `shop` (label `app=shop`, container port `80`) is running, but the Service `shop-svc` returns nothing when curled on its ClusterIP.

Diagnose using `kubectl get endpoints shop-svc -n exam-q16`. The Service has a wrong selector and a wrong `targetPort`. Fix both so the Service correctly forwards to the `shop` Pods on port `80`. Do not change the Deployment.

questions.title: NetworkPolicy — Ingress, Egress and DNS
questions.body:
In Namespace `exam-q17` there are three Pods: `client` (`app=client`), `api` (`app=api`) and `db` (`app=db`).

Create a NetworkPolicy named `api-policy` selecting Pod `api` that:
- Allows **ingress** only from `client` on TCP port `80`
- Allows **egress** only to `db` on TCP port `5432`
- Also allows egress to UDP and TCP port `53` (DNS) so name resolution keeps working

questions.title: Ingress with Multiple Paths
questions.body:
In Namespace `exam-q18` there are two Services: `web-svc` (port `80`) and `metrics-svc` (port `9090`).

Create an Ingress named `site-ingress` with `ingressClassName: nginx` and host `site.ckad.com`:
- Path `/` (`pathType: Prefix`) → `web-svc` port `80`
- Path `/metrics` (`pathType: Prefix`) → `metrics-svc` port `9090`

questions.title: PersistentVolumeClaim and Pod
questions.body:
In Namespace `exam-q19`:
1. Create a PersistentVolumeClaim named `content-pvc` requesting `1Gi`, access mode `ReadWriteOnce`, StorageClass `standard`.
2. Create a Pod named `content-pod` using image `nginx:alpine` that mounts the PVC at `/usr/share/nginx/html`.

Confirm the PVC is `Bound` and the Pod is `Running`.

questions.title: Parallel Job
questions.body:
In Namespace `exam-q20` create a Job named `batch-calc` that:
- Uses image `busybox:1.36`
- Runs command `sh -c 'echo processed $(date +%s); sleep 3'`
- Has `completions: 6` and `parallelism: 2`
- Sets `backoffLimit: 2` and `restartPolicy: Never`

Wait until the Job reports `6` successful completions.
